Marta (product): Quick sync — need to lock the visibility contracts (dashboards, tracing hooks, cost + error analytics) and rollout guardrails before sprint planning tomorrow.
Devin: +1. What are the non-negotiables for MVP?
Marta (product): MVP must show per-route latency (p50/p95), error rate, cost-per-request. Tracing: auto-span for request entry + model inference. Sampling can be lower.
Sophia SRE: We can add tracing hooks in runtime; concern = overhead. Proposal: hot-path only (routes with >5 qps) + 5% sampling elsewhere.
Ryan (data): For cost breakdown we need token counts + infra GPU time. Can we get per-request token delta from runtime?
Devin: runtime already emits token_count metric but no per-route aggregation. Should be straightforward to tag.
engbot: Created ticket INF-9823 (trace hooks) and MET-7731 (dashboards) from this thread :white_check_mark:
Marta (product): Acceptance criteria draft:
```
- Dashboard: route-level rows for top 20 routes showing p50/p95 latency, error rate, cost/request
- Tracing: request entry span + inference span; default sampling 10%; tag model_variant
- Cost: token_count + infra_ms per request -> cost model calculated hourly
- Rollout: canary 10% traffic for 72h; abort if error rate increases > 1.5x or p95 regresses > 20%
```
Sophia SRE: 72h canary ok. Add SLI for tracing overhead: CPU increase < 3%.
Ryan (data): I'll own cost model and a nightly job to recompute unit costs. Need schema for tags.
Devin: I'll scope dashboard widgets (topology + filters) and wire tags. ETA for PR by EOD Thu.
Marta (product): Owners: Sophia -> tracing hooks, Devin -> dashboard + rollout, Ryan -> cost model. I'll coordinate PM acceptance and customer comms. Any blockers?
Devin: Need confirmation on sampling library (OpenTelemetry ok?).
Sophia SRE: Yes, OTel + adaptive sampler. I can send config snippet.
Marta (product): Great — update tickets and we'll finalize in planning. Thanks :thumbsup:
